Alice Sales: Hey @Carla, Dan from Acme (cc @Ben) — they want to reuse some of their Elastic IPs for our Dedicated endpoint in the POC. Is that feasible?

Carla NetEng: Short: we don't accept customer-owned EIPs on hosted Dedicated endpoints. We can support three options:
1) Customer allowlist our outbound EIPs (we can provide up to a small set of static IPs per pool)
2) Site-to-site VPN / VPC peering / Private deployment so traffic originates from customer side
3) Customer-side reverse proxy that forwards to our endpoint (adds latency but keeps control on their network)

Ben SE: For a fast POC I usually recommend a temporary allowlist window + short-lived API key. Steps I propose:
- We provide a list of outbound IPs (example below)
- Customer whitelists for 48-72h
- Customer runs a curl smoke test to verify egress

Carla NetEng: Example IPs (placeholder, final will come from infra):
```
3.210.45.12
3.210.45.13
3.210.45.14/32
```
Note: SNI-based allowlisting or hostname allowlist is brittle with TLS termination and CDNs — prefer IPs + mTLS if you can enable it.

Dan (Acme): Ok. What about keeping all egress behind our NAT gateway and peering to you? We can't open inbound to internet from prod.

Carla NetEng: If you need egress to originate from your VPC, the right path is Private deployment or VPC peering with our private endpoints (enterprise contract required). For POC the whitelisting approach is the fastest.

Alice Sales: Quick pricing question: any extra charges for providing static egress IPs / reserved capacity for this POC? Does it impact the quote?

Ben SE: There is a small infra add-on for reserved static IPs on Dedicated pools. I'll add a line item to the POC quote and mark it optional. No change to base per-token pricing for the trial.

Dan (Acme): Can you create a ticket I can share with our security team that includes the CIDRs and expected allowlist window?

Ben SE: Yep — opening ticket now and will attach the test curl.

Ben SE: ```
curl -X POST https://dedicated.acme.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-poc-xxxx" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input": "hello"}'
```

Carla NetEng: Also adding a note for production: we recommend Private deployment + site-to-site VPN and KMS integration for key control. If they need audit logs we can enable extended retention as an add-on.

infra-bot: Support ticket #789012 created by @Ben SE — assigned to eng-net. ETA 2 business days

Alice Sales: Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
